params.message:
A copied vehicle shows its photos instead of grey tiles

Copying a vehicle moved each photo's files to the copy's folder but kept
the original's media_version and media_set. The photo URL builder reads
those as "derived sizes exist for this path" and pointed md, sm and the
thumbnail at _afgeleid/{copy path}/... files that were never written, so
every tile on both photo tabs stayed grey while the lightbox (the plain
file) opened fine.

A copied row whose shown file moves now carries no version, like a fresh
upload: the URL falls back to the plain file and the five-minute sweep
derives the copy's own sizes. A row that still shows the original's file
keeps its version. Same rule as the bought-over copy (R S5-3.17).

Existing copies are repaired with
php artisan stocklist:fotos-afgeleid --missing --wagen=<id> --apply.

Portal: Foto's van een gekopieerde wagen tonen opnieuw meteen in de tegels.
